pricing.title: Cocoa price
pricing.description: This is the price Cashiers and the Financial Secretary see when recording a purchase.
pricing.historyProtection: Past purchases keep the price that applied when they were recorded.
pricing.newPriceHint: This applies to purchases from now on. Past purchases keep the price they were recorded at.
pricing.publishDescription: This becomes the price for every purchase recorded from now on.
pricing.effectiveFromHint: Leave empty to start today. A price cannot be back-dated.
pricing.emptyDescription: Publish a price so Cashiers can record purchases.
pricing.confirmDescription: The price becomes {{price}} per kg. Every purchase recorded from now on will use it, and it cannot be undone.
